item.title: Seattle approaching longest January dry stretch
item.description: Sunday marked the coldest morning temperature at Sea-Tac Airport since February 2025. Along with the cold, Seattleites are seeing a unique dry stretch.

item.title: Pierce County deputies shoot armed man in Parkland, WA
item.description: Pierce County deputies were involved in a shooting after a man and his dog were stabbed in Parkland on Sunday.

item.title: Matty Beniers, Berkly Catton score 18 seconds apart in 3rd period as Seattle Kraken beat Devils 4-2
item.description: Matty Beniers and Berkly Catton scored 18 seconds apart in the third period, Joey Daccord made 27 saves and the Seattle Kraken beat the New Jersey Devils 4-2 on Sunday.

item.title: Who raised the 12 flag at Sunday's NFC championship game Rams vs. Seahawks
item.description: Jody Allen raised the 12 Flag at Lumen Field ahead of the Seattle Seahawks’ NFC Championship game, continuing the team’s pregame tradition honoring fans as the 12th player.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks to play New England Patriots in Super Bowl 2026
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks will face the New England Patriots in Super Bowl 2026 on Feb. 8 at 3:30 p.m. PT at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara.

item.title: LIVE: Rams vs Seahawks scores, updates in NFC championship game in Seattle
item.description: Get the the latest scores, updates and highlights as the Seattle Seahawks take on the Los Angeles Rams in the NFC championship.

item.title: Seahawks advance to Super Bowl in thrilling 31-27 win over Rams for NFC title
item.description: Sam Darnold threw three touchdowns and Seattle’s defense sealed the game with a late fourth-down stop as the Seahawks beat the Rams 31–27 to win the NFC Championship and reach their first Super Bowl in 11 years.

item.title: Super Bowl 60 pits Patriots, Seahawks against each other in 2015 rematch
item.description: The New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks will meet in Super Bowl 60 for a long-awaited rematch 11 years after their iconic Super Bowl showdown.

item.title: Seahawks vs Patriots: Everything to know about Super Bowl 2026
item.description: Super Bowl 2026 will take place on February 8, 2026. From kickoff to the halftime show to how to watch, here's everything to know about the big game.
